cards.label: UK insolvencies
cards.text: Accommodation & food service insolvencies in the 12 months to December 2025 — 14% of all UK cases and the third-highest sector, behind construction and retail/wholesale (UK Government figures).
cards.source: UK Gov figures via The Drinks Business

cards.label: Ireland stabilising
cards.text: Irish hospitality insolvencies in H1 2026 — down 26% on H1 2025 and below the sector's quarterly average since 2023. The Irish backdrop is easing while the UK's tightens; frame accordingly.

cards.label: Pub closures
cards.text: British pubs closed in Q1 2026, up 26% on the same quarter last year, with more than 2,400 job losses (BBPA figures).

cards.label: Budget cost load
cards.text: The BBPA's estimate of the annual business costs the November 2025 Budget measures added for pubs and brewers — the sector's own number for what April's bills look like.

cards.label: Staffing gap
cards.text: Open roles in UK accommodation & food services — 3 vacancies per 100 workers against 2.3 economy-wide. The ops burden of covering shifts is a live pain in most conversations.

cards.label: Summer footfall
cards.text: Weekly UK hospitality footfall year-on-year, lifted by warm weather and the World Cup — demand shows up when the occasion is right; the fight is margin, not appetite.
